text_block_list.text:
It is the day of the exhibition race, 
where legendary Umamusume from across the 
globe have gathered—and Buena Vista was 
among those invited.

As a major race after quite some time, 
just before the start of the autumn race 
season— the venue was bursting with 
immense excitement.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! Amazing, there's so many 
people~...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Plus, ev~eryone was smiling... There were 
tons of food stalls, so it felt like a 
festival♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
To be invited to such a massive race. 
You're amazing, Buena-san...—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
What an incredible lineup... Though all 
eyes are on Buena Vista after all!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe she's actually showing up! 
She's an active top-tier Umamusume, you 
know? She could totally turn down an offer 
like this!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that comment? "I want to give 
it my all to meet the fans' 
expectations"... she said. Man, how can 
you not root for her?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Show the world the power of Japan's 
heroine! Buena-chan, you can do it!

The expectations placed on Buena Vista 
were just as immense as ever... No, today, 
they seemed to have swelled to even 
greater heights than before.

Boasting an overwhelming #1 spot in "The 
1st" as well, everyone believes without a 
shadow of a doubt in the strongest 
heroine's victory. That's the kind of air 
surrounding her.
choice_data_list: Buena, just run like you always do.
Buena, just run like you always do.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "It's okay. I understand."

Ever since entering the waiting room, 
Buena Vista seemed a bit off. Her whole 
body was tense, and her expression was 
stiff.
choice_data_list: Buena, let's take a deep breath.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: *Inhale*... ...*Phew*...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, thank you.
choice_data_list:
...Is there anything else you want me to 
do?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I'm okay! ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I have to get going soon. I'll do my best!

Buena Vista is a very strong Umamusume. 
That's why after sending her off... I 
never felt any frustration. But right now—
choice_data_list:
(It's so frustrating that we can't run 
together...)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Hk, phew...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Deep breath, deep breath... It's okay, 
everything's fine...—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...*pant*, *pant*. *whew*...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (...Ngh, no. Trainer, I... really am...!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, no. —I can't rely on them...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I have to fight—all on my own.
(Waaaaaaah...!! Buena Vista~~!!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(Their voices... are getting heavier and 
heavier... My chest feels tight... My ears 
are blocking up...)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (—So heavy. Everyone's expectations are—)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...No, that's not it...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
They're cheers. They're rooting for me. 
...It's trust...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is waiting. So many people... are 
waiting for my victory...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I have to win. I have to live up to it...! 
—Turning their expectations into power...!

And so, the exhibition race began under 
monumental expectations, but—

Buena Vista bides her time at the back... 
without rushing... patiently saving up her 
stamina—
(Waaah...!!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...I have to answer their hopes...! 
Haaah...—!!

Exploding down the final stretch with her 
signature late-stage burst, she crossed 
the line in 1st place in glorious fashion. 
However—

text_block_list.name: Buena Fan A
text_block_list.text:
...Wh-!? Huh...? W-Wait. The board... the 
inquiry lamp is flashing...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Uh... the inquiry has now concluded. 
Regarding Buena Vista, who crossed the 
finish line in first place—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Due to interfering with another 
Umamusume's path, she is demoted to second 
place. Moving up to take first is—
(Murmur...!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"No waaaay!? Buena-chan got demoted, for 
real!?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
I thought her running looked a bit rough, 
but... Buena Vista... what in the world 
happened to you...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Buena-san...
(—What a disappointment.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...I'm, sorry...—

After the race... alongside her, we 
sincerely apologized to the Umamusume 
whose path had been blocked and to the 
race officials. And the moment we returned 
to the waiting room—

Tears welled up in Buena Vista's eyes, and 
then... they flowed endlessly down her 
cheeks.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, everyone... I'm sorry, 
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
What I did... is utterly unforgivable... 
Even though... everyone cheered... for me 
like that...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Gh, I-I'm sorry...! ...Ugh, uuuu...!

No matter how much I rubbed her back... 
her tears kept spilling over. Just how 
much guilt was welling up inside this 
slender body—
choice_data_list:
(Sorry I can only be by your side in my 
imagination...)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me, please pardon me.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Um... Buena-san—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh, Spe-san...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I... ngh, I did... something 
terrible...!

Leaving Buena Vista in Special Week's 
care, I stepped outside. It was to 
apologize to the fans who were heading 
home.
choice_data_list: I am terribly sorry about today...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Buena Vista's Trainer? Why are you 
apologizing?

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text:
"Saying, 'I'm sorry for letting down not 
just the team, but the fans' expectations 
today,' along with—"

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text:
"He said, 'Please continue to warmly watch 
over Buena Vista.' ...Though it feels a 
bit early for that, don't you think?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Fan A
text_block_list.text: ...... Buena-chan.

Right after the race, I saw a despondent 
Buena Vista back to her family home... The 
next morning, after handling all sorts of 
aftermath like dealing with the media.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'm back.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ...I'm sorry for causing trouble.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Back then, I wasn't paying attention to my 
surroundings at all... I think I just 
panicked.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I thought... I had to do my best all on my 
own...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Because... ...Because.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"To you... you of all people, I just 
couldn't say it. —That 'your expectations 
are heavy.'"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...I shouldn't have run while panicking 
like that."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
If only I had followed Trainer's 
instructions back then and chosen not to 
run...
choice_data_list: Still, in the end, I made the decision.
Still, in the end, it was my decision.

text_block_list.text:
"I'm the one who should apologize for 
holding back." ...I swallow those words. 
Right now, an apology would only burden 
her.
choice_data_list:
Let's reflect on what went wrong, then 
switch gears.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Still.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I guess everyone's... stopped expecting 
anything from me now."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...The breathtaking view feels so far away 
now.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer... Even though I wanted 
to make it there together with you...

I take what happened very seriously as 
well. However—

"They stopped expecting anything from 
me"... Is that really true?

Buena Vista admirably put on a cheerful 
front and vowed to make a comeback. 
Naturally, though, it's not something she 
can just shake off right away...

Besides... it was a shock. I felt so 
pathetic. To think she had been fighting 
all alone...

—A breathtaking view is a dream meant to 
be reached together, yet...

It was an email sent by a certain fan. Its 
contents were—

"We want to hold an event to cheer up 
Buena Vista-chan"—they were asking if we 
could help with that.

—I replied immediately. Adding, "I'd be 
delighted to help."
